verdict.rationale: Name.com offers webhook subscriptions for domain/account events (transfers, renewals, compliance notices) which can trigger downstream automation, and its API/MCP server allows agents to act on data, but there is no evidence of a user-facing rules engine (e.g., 'if X happens then do Y' conditional automation) — webhooks only notify, they don't let users define trigger-action rules within the product itself. missing for 10: a native rules/automation engine or conditional trigger-action builder, evidence of chaining triggers to specific automated actions, and independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
